content: The transformative journey of the mining industry remains a focal point of ongoing research, emphasizing a promising future shaped by emerging technologies [120] . For a competitive intelligence entity operating within South Africa's IT sector, understanding this trajectory is paramount. The progression from a 15.0 percent adoption rate to a 58.0 percent adoption rate in just four years highlights a sector that is aggressively modernizing its digital infrastructure. Although current, region-specific data for South Africa in 2026 may be limited in broader global reports, the established momentum indicates that autonomous systems, edge computing, and artificial intelligence are no longer peripheral experiments but core operational imperatives. The primary objective of integrating these technologies is to enable smarter, more efficient mining operations, a trend that gained significant traction between 2020 and 2024. Supporting this technological backbone are massive capital injections from global technology leaders. For instance, Microsoft has committed to expanding its investments in cloud and AI infrastructure, including plans to invest ZAR 5.4 billion by 2027 [132] . As of June 2026, connectivity solutions in the South African mining industry have become a critical focus as technological advancements aim to address operational efficiencies, safety, and productivity in the sector. Mining environments are notoriously harsh and complex, often characterized by deep underground shafts, expansive open-pit topographies, and significant electromagnetic interference. Consequently, standard commercial networking solutions are frequently inadequate. A notable example of this innovation is Tharisa’s implementation of an adaptive wireless solution from Datacentrix, which has been described as the first of its kind in Africa . Operational for approximately a year, this technology has successfully provided reliable and robust connectivity within the challenging environment of the Tharisa mining site . Its adaptive capabilities have enhanced communication and data transfer, which are pivotal in modern mining operations to ensure seamless processes and improved safety standards [132] . The success of the adaptive wireless solution at Tharisa serves as a vital case study for the broader industry, demonstrating the tangible benefits of customized IT deployments in resource extraction.
